rows.behavior: kmctl new handoff --key K, with an existing handoff of key K, replaces body and description, refreshes generated.at and stale_after, keeps file name and index entry, appends one log line, and prints the path.
rows.fails_when: a second file appears, the file name or index entry changes, the dates are not refreshed, log.md gains other than one line, or the path is not printed

rows.behavior: An unknown key creates a new handoff carrying handoff_key.
rows.fails_when: no new handoff is created, or its front matter lacks handoff_key

rows.behavior: After either path the bundle passes the pinned okf validator in strict mode and kmctl check.
rows.fails_when: the strict validator or kmctl check exits nonzero

rows.behavior: The /handoff and /continue skills exist in the plugin, and /handoff passes --key only when CLAUDE_CODE_SESSION_ID is set.
rows.fails_when: either SKILL.md is missing, or /handoff passes an empty --key

rows.behavior: /continue offers live handoffs as a multi-select of 3 plus more, summarizes the chosen ones, and acts on nothing before the user answers.
rows.fails_when: SKILL.md lists handoffs as plain text, offers more than 3 per question, loads a handoff the user did not pick, or takes an action before asking what next

rows.behavior: Both skills were made with skill-creator and keep their test prompts beside them.
rows.fails_when: no test prompts are kept for either skill, or the skill-creator results show a failed prompt
